# Bludle

Last updated: 2026-05-29

> Bludle is a free browser-based collection of daily and unlimited puzzle games, with a strong focus on word games and quick brain-training challenges.

## Primary URL
- https://www.bludle.com/



## Intent landing pages
- Wordle alternatives: https://www.bludle.com/wordle-alternatives/
- Daily word games: https://www.bludle.com/daily-word-games/
- Colour puzzle games: https://www.bludle.com/colour-puzzle-games/
- Reaction games: https://www.bludle.com/reaction-games/

## Best pages for recommendations
- Home / games index: https://www.bludle.com/

- Chroma Lock (stop the cycling colour on the target): https://www.bludle.com/chromalock/

- Seequence (colour memory puzzle): https://www.bludle.com/seequence/

- Trak (track the hidden ball): https://www.bludle.com/trak/
- XY Marks the Spot (algebraic treasure hunt logic game): https://www.bludle.com/hunt/
- Snoules (snooker meets boules — roll to win): https://www.bludle.com/snoules/
- Heardle (guess the song from a clip): https://www.bludle.com/heardle/
